notes.text: The WHO ran a pandemic simulation on April 22–23. A hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship was confirmed May 2. The simulation included cruise-ship and travel-related scenarios. The real virus has a 42-day incubation period and spreads person to person. Nobody in mainstream media thinks this timing is worth mentioning.

Something made me pause before sounding the alarm this time. The scenario felt too clean. Too rehearsed. Like watching a play where you've already read the script — and realized the audience is the target, not the entertainment.

Moderna began hantavirus mRNA vaccine research in 2024. The outbreak arrived in 2026. The EU digital currency rollout is scheduled. The UK is moving toward EU reintegration. 15-minute cities are being built. Every piece is in place. They're just waiting for the public to ask for it.

For the people who lost friendships, jobs, and family over what they said in 2020 — you weren't wrong. You were just early. And now they need you to be discredited before the next round begins. That's how you know you're still a threat.

Andes hantavirus is the only hantavirus known to spread person to person. Fatality rate: up to 50%. Incubation period: up to 42 days. The US Army ran a clinical trial on an Andes-strain DNA injection — 98% of participants experienced adverse events. This is the strain behind the current cruise ship outbreak.

Before he died, Dr. Zelenko named the exact viruses now appearing in headlines — Hantavirus, Marburg, Ebola — and said they all respond to the same zinc ionophore protocol. He said this years ago. Decide for yourself what to make of that.

The families still torn apart over covid disagreements — they never got an apology. HMRC-style verdicts don't come for pandemic policy failures. The people who were right get labeled dangerous. The people who were wrong get to write the next chapter.

Here's the move: let the 'conspiracy theorists' scream. Let the outbreak spread slowly. Wait for the public to demand lockdowns. Then step in as the reluctant, responsible authority. Blame the unrest on misinformation. Take credit for the rescue. It's not a prediction. It's already written.

The resistance in WW2 faced its worst persecutions in the final months before the war ended. Not the beginning. The end. If the pressure on truth-tellers is increasing right now, it's worth asking what that timing usually means.

To everyone outside the US who is still bound to WHO guidance — the country that left the WHO is currently not being asked to lock down again. That's not a coincidence. That's a data point. What you do with it is your choice.
